Record Class CatalogData

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.cssd2101.lab02.CatalogData
Record Components:
id - unique nonblank catalogue identifier (not necessarily an ISBN)
title - nonblank display title
creator - nonblank primary creator
priceCents - nonnegative exact cents
year - publication year in 1450..2027
public record CatalogData(String id, String title, String creator, long priceCents, int year) extends Record
Immutable shared metadata, with edition-specific years 1450..2027.

  • Constructor Details

    • CatalogData

      public CatalogData(String id, String title, String creator, long priceCents, int year)
      Validates and strips text; performs no I/O or clock access.
      Parameters:
      id - catalogue identifier
      title - display title
      creator - primary creator
      priceCents - nonnegative exact cents
      year - publication year
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if any string is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if text is blank, cents negative or year out of range

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
